method: Head-to-head. Path A: non-English prompt straight to the model, answer in the same language. Path B: prompt translated to English, model answers in English, answer translated back. Every token on both paths is counted, including the translator's own calls.
headline: Across six prompts the proxy cost 6.9% MORE than not using it. Only Korean bounded questions won clearly. The break-even model (English reply must be >=38% shorter on this model pair) predicted 5 of 6 outcomes correctly.
caveat: Four of six replies hit max_tokens. A truncated reply is pinned to the same length in both languages, so it cannot shrink and the fee buys nothing. Real savings depend on answers finishing naturally.
